note: Polio is a highly infectious viral disease. The polio virus invades the nervous system and can cause irreversible paralysis. This indicator was discontinued by WHO and UNICEF in 2026 and is no longer updated after 2024.
title: Number of one-year-olds who are not fully vaccinated against polio
subtitle: Number of one-year-olds who have not received the third dose of polio-containing vaccine. This may be either the [oral](#dod:oral-polio-vaccine) or the [inactivated polio vaccine](#dod:inactivated-polio-vaccine).
